Find the Optimal Number of Cut-points for Survival Data

Source: R/find_cutpoint_number.R
find_cutpoint_number.Rd

Determines the optimal number of cut-points (from 0 to `max_cuts`) for a continuous variable in a survival context by comparing models using an information criterion (AIC, AICc, or BIC).

Usage

find_cutpoint_number(
  data,
  predictor,
  outcome_time,
  outcome_event,
  method = "systematic",
  criterion = "BIC",
  covariates = NULL,
  max_cuts = 2,
  nmin = 0.1,
  seed = NULL,
  maxiter = 100,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'find_cutpoint_number_result'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'find_cutpoint_number_result'
summary(
  object,
  show_comparison_table = TRUE,
  show_best_model_details = TRUE,
  show_group_counts = TRUE,
  show_medians = TRUE,
  plot.it = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'find_cutpoint_number_result'
plot(x, y, ...)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the variables.

predictor

The name of the predictor variable, as a string.

outcome_time

The name of the time variable, as a string.

outcome_event

The name of the event variable, as a string.

method

The algorithm to use: "systematic" or "genetic".

criterion

The information criterion ("AIC", "AICc", or "BIC") to use for model selection.

covariates

A character vector of covariate names to include in the model.

max_cuts

The maximum number of cut-points to test for.

nmin

The minimum number of observations in each group.

seed

An optional integer for setting the random seed to ensure reproducible results when using the "genetic" method.

maxiter

The number of generations for the genetic algorithm. Default is 100.

...

Additional arguments passed to the genetic algorithm.

x

An object of class find_cutpoint_number_result (for S3 methods).

object

An object of class find_cutpoint_number_result (for S3 methods).

show_comparison_table

Logical. If TRUE, shows the model comparison table.

show_best_model_details

Logical. If TRUE, shows full details for the best model.

show_group_counts

Logical. If TRUE, shows group counts for the best model.

show_medians

Logical. If TRUE, shows median survival for the best model.

plot.it

Logical. If TRUE, displays the model selection plot.

y

Unused.

Value

An object of class `find_cutpoint_number_result`. This is a list containing a data frame of the model comparison results, the analysis parameters, the data used, optimal_num_cuts, and optimal_cuts.
